items.quote: We must urgently track and regularly publish underemployment measures to enable Singaporeans to assess if the government’s efforts to get these workers into suitable full-time employment have been successful.
We must institutionalise independence in these bodies and improve public confidence in them.
We must institute a Freedom of Information Act to allow citizens to be able to make requests for information from public agencies, at the level of detail that is requested.
To protect our forests, we must have stronger environmentally-focused laws, and more ecologically-conscious land-use planning.
We must preserve the little that remains of our forests, coastal mangroves and protected land rather than remove it all in the name of urban development.

Additionally, we must require that listed and large firms that are major emitters routinely report environmental audits for all their planned projects and during major milestones of developing these projects.
